embeds.title: OPEN A TICKET
embeds.description: Need the Commissioner? Pick the type of ticket from the menu below. A private channel opens for you and the Commissioner. Nothing you write there is public.

fields.name: OPEN A TICKET FOR
fields.value:
❓ General Help
🔄 Trade Review
⚖️ Rules Ruling / Appeal
🏒 Roster / Fantrax Problem
🎯 Draft Issue
⚙️ Server / Bot Problem

fields.name: COMMISSIONER ONLY
fields.value:
💰 Dues & Payment
🚩 Report a Member
🤝🏻 Ownership Change

These stay private to the Commissioner.

fields.name: TIMING
fields.value: A request to review a material Commissioner ruling must be made within 48 hours of the ruling (Section 19.4). A trade misclick or platform error must be reported within 48 hours of the trade processing (Section 11.2).

fields.name: BEFORE YOU OPEN ONE
fields.value: Questions the whole league could use the answer to belong in **❓│rules-questions**. You can have up to 3 tickets open at once.

fields.name: PRIVACY
fields.value: Never post passwords, card numbers or bank account numbers in a ticket.
